paper_metadata.title: Simultaneously improving strength-ductility and corrosion resistance of high-Cr Ni-Cr alloys via Nb doping

evidence.quote: Ni-based alloys with high chromium content are promising candidates for harsh-environment applications due to their exceptional strength-ductility synergy and corrosion resistance.

evidence.section: 4.2. The impact of Nb doping on the strength-ductility balance
evidence.quote: The primary strengthening mechanisms for the Nb-free alloy are solid solution strengthening and dislocation strengthening, whereas the principal strengthening mechanisms for the 1Nb alloy are precipitation strengthening and dislocation strengthening.
